{{Otheruses|Secretary}}
The '''First Secretary''',<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> also known as the '''Council Chief''', was the title of the leader of the [[Combined Bothan Clans]]. It was the highest post in [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] society and members of the council selected one of their own to fill the position. The First Secretary held the power to cast a tie-breaking vote in the event of a deadlocked issue.<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> The office was once held by [[Desark Fey'lya]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="WindRaiders">''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]''</ref> As of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Savielk Trey'dra]] was the current Council Chief and the de facto ruler of the Bothan people.<ref name="SotEPG" /> During the [[Caamas Document]] crisis, [[Ceok Orou'cya]] served as First Secretary.<ref name="SotP" />
